scopeRefresh: COM finishes root/project and COM locks first and passes its complete immutable snapshot
ACC locks project-level new-origin roots whose frozen rule.scopeCheck=COM_CURRENT_SCOPE, including such roots opened with empty scope; other project acceptance roots are not subscribed
same observed version: replay; older supplied version: SCOPE_STALE; higher: append missing allocation bindings and CAS observed version
do not call back to PROJ or COM after ACC locks
do not rewrite old reports, historical completion or node state; current fact/version checks invalidate stale dependency results
algorithms.emptyScope: Only for COM_CURRENT_SCOPE: scopeVersion 0 with both lists empty is a known empty fact and is persisted for later scope tracking; it does not auto-pass completion. NOT_REQUIRED instead stores NULL scope fields and never calls COM. Neither case equals provider unavailable.
algorithms.duplicateIntent: same operation+canonical payload replays; direct create with another intent for the same project/type conflicts; node/BPM resolution may return RESOLVED_EXISTING for the same project/type and compatible frozen rule, without changing original origin, rule or reports; distinct evidence scopes/intents are not silently merged
algorithms.legacy: old methods/records/data stay valid for original callers; new paths never fill fake stage/task IDs; new refresh/guard callers must distinguish both source kinds
algorithms.sourceCapture: BpmProcessInstanceStatusEvent is a signal only; verify actual ended APPROVE(2) Flowable instance, tenant, start user, definition identity, businessKey and frozen action; capture approved trigger to existing outbox, then execute independently under revalidated originating actor
algorithms.scopeApplicability: Every acceptance is project-level. COM_CURRENT_SCOPE is an explicit business-rule dependency, not a global creation prerequisite. NOT_REQUIRED never calls COM and requires expectedScopeVersion NULL; COM unavailable must not block an acceptance whose rule does not reference COM.
algorithms.definitionSelection: frozenUse NULL means a new rule selection and requires published/enabled revision; non-null frozenUse is checked against PROJ-owned frozen node/trigger references and permits historical definition interpretation without silently changing the revision. Actual writes still require the target provider's supported operation and current authorization.
algorithms.existingRuleCompatibility: projectId and acceptanceType must match and ruleRevisionId must equal the root's frozen rule_revision_id; do not merge merely semantically similar rules or replace origin/rule snapshots. Legacy roots without a frozen rule are not auto-upgraded.
